Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

available adjective

at hand, to be had

also at hand, to hand, obtainable, make available, if it’s available, in stock, is it available?

classical

Caes. BG 1.16.2: nē pābulī quidem satis magna cōpia suppetēbat
Cic. Fam. 15.13.2: mihi ad remūnerandum nihil suppetat praeter voluntātem

suppetō, suppetere, suppetīvī, suppetītum

verb, third conjugation, intransitive; to whom, the dative

be available, be at hand, be in store

Latin says “X is available” with a verb: suppetit, it is there to be had.

Other words

  • in prōmptū esse — be ready to hand; be obvious

    also used · classical · Gell. 2.29.20: hoc erit tibi argūmentum semper in prōmptū situm; Quint. 11.2.43: nec in prōmptū ratiō; Traupman 68

  • parābilis, parābile — easy to get, readily available

    also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 1.36; Tusc. 5.93 (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. available: easily available

  • cōpiam facere — make available, give access to

    to whom, the dative; of what, the genitive · also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 113: sibi ut ejus faciat cōpiam; M-O s.v. available: make available

  • praestō esse — be at hand, be available (of things as well as people)

    also used · classical · Cic. Pis. 55: togulae līctōribus ad portam praestō fuērunt (Lewis & Short s.v. praestō); Traupman 114: sī praestō est, if it’s available

Examples

  • hoc erit tibi argūmentum semper in prōmptū situm: nē quid expectēs amīcōs, quod tūte agere possiēs

    keep this lesson always to hand: don’t wait for your friends to do what you can do yourselfEnnius in Gell. 2.29.20

  • ut tibi ad mē ōrnandum semper dētur facultās, mihi ad remūnerandum nihil suppetat praeter voluntātem

    that you always have the means to do me honour, and I have nothing available to repay you with but goodwillCic. Fam. 15.13.2

  • Estne in prōmptū placenta ex socolātā?

    Is chocolate cake available?Traupman 68

See also available.
